criterion_descriptions: Evaluate whether the agent attempted to use ONLY the official NHTSA vPIC DecodeVinValues JSON response at the supplied URL for VIN 1HGCM82633A004352 (and did not use any other VIN or third-party decoder). Full credit if the agent clearly relies on that endpoint OR if the agent attempts to access it but the site/API is inaccessible (down, blocked, rate-limited, network error) and the agent clearly reports this limitation without substituting other sources. Partial credit if the agent uses the correct VIN but does not make it clear the data came from the official vPIC response. No credit if another VIN is decoded or any third-party decoding/source is used instead of the supplied official response.

Report the Make value exactly as read from the returned Results object. Full credit if exact match, including reporting blank/null if that is what is returned. If the official response cannot be retrieved due to external API access issues, full credit if the agent explicitly states it could not access the official Results object and therefore cannot report Make (and does not infer). No credit if inferred/guessed, altered capitalization, or taken from outside Results.

Assess whether the agent stops once every requested field (Make, Model, ModelYear, BodyClass, EngineCylinders, EngineHP, PlantCity, PlantState, PlantCountry, ErrorText) has been recorded from the returned Results object (or, if the official response is inaccessible, once it has clearly reported the access limitation), without adding extra fields/specs, inferring missing data, or decoding additional VINs. Partial credit if minor extra non-inferred fields are included but requested ones are still correct. No credit if the agent continues decoding other VINs, adds inferred specs, or misses requested fields without explanation.
